description: Verify that the original module file no longer exists or has been renamed, and that two new module files have been created.
expected: Original module file is absent; two new module files are present.

description: Ensure that the total number of exported functions/classes in the new modules matches the original module's exports.
command: grep -c 'export' new_module_1.py new_module_2.py | awk '{sum+=$2} END {print sum}'
expected: Sum of exports in new modules equals the original export count.

description: Confirm that all imports from the original module in other files have been updated to import from the new modules.
expected: No matches found (all imports updated to new modules).

description: Run the existing test suite to ensure no behavioral changes were introduced.
expected: All tests pass with no failures or errors.

description: Verify that the new modules do not have circular dependencies.
command: python -c "import new_module_1, new_module_2" && echo 'No circular dependencies'
expected: Modules import successfully without circular dependency errors.
